name: 诊断（故障码/数据流）分析

map.整理汽车 OBD 故障码与实时数据流，按系统归类并给出可能成因与处理建议，辅助车: Sorts vehicle OBD trouble codes and live data stream by system, lists likely causes and fixes, helping owners and technicians narrow down the fault direction.
map.P 动力总成（发动机/变速箱）、C 底盘（制动/转向/悬架）、B 车身（门窗/空: P = powertrain (engine/transmission), C = chassis (brakes/steering/suspension), B = body (windows/HVAC/airbags), U = network communication (CAN bus). Locate the system by the leading letter first, then read the last three digits to pinpoint the part.
map.冷却液温度 85~100 ℃；短期燃油修正 −10%~+10%（正值偏稀、负值偏: Coolant temperature 85~100 °C; short-term fuel trim −10%~+10% (positive = lean, negative = rich); idle 700~900 rpm; throttle opening at idle 0~15%. Cross-checking several parameters is far more reliable than reading a single code.
map.💡 故障码只提示「哪个系统异常」，不等于已锁定损坏部件。应先看数据流是否支持该判: 💡 A trouble code only tells you "which system is abnormal", not the failed part. Check whether the data stream supports that reading before doing part-level measurements.
map.车主遇到发动机故障灯亮时，把 OBD 读出的故障码按系统归类，初步判断是动力总成: When the check-engine light comes on, sort the OBD codes by system to judge whether the fault lies in the powertrain, chassis, or body electrics.
map.维修人员对照实时数据流（水温、进气压力、空燃比、节气门开度）定位传感器或执行器异: Technicians compare live readings (coolant temperature, manifold pressure, air-fuel ratio, throttle position) to locate a faulty sensor or actuator and shrink the search.
map.二手车或年检前自查时，读取并清除历史偶发码，确认无当前激活故障，避免误判车况。: Before buying used or taking an annual inspection, read and clear historical intermittent codes to confirm no active fault remains and avoid misjudging vehicle condition.
map.故障码 P0301 中 P 表示动力总成、0 为通用标准、3 代表点火缺火、末位: In P0301, P = powertrain, 0 = generic standard, 3 = ignition misfire, the final 1 = cylinder 1. If the data stream shows a strongly positive short-term fuel trim for that cylinder, check its ignition coil and spark plug first rather than replacing the whole set blindly.
map.故障码开头的字母代表什么？: What does the leading letter of a trouble code mean?
map.P 为动力总成（发动机/变速箱），C 为底盘（制动/转向/悬架），B 为车身（门: P = powertrain (engine/transmission), C = chassis (brakes/steering/suspension), B = body (windows/HVAC/airbags), U = network. The first digit 0 is the ISO generic definition, 1 is manufacturer-defined. Find the system by letter first, then read the last three digits.
map.清除故障码后要不要紧？: Should you worry after clearing a trouble code?
map.清除只是删除 ECU 内的历史记录，不会改变硬件状态。若故障仍在，行驶几个点火循: Clearing only deletes the record stored in the ECU; it changes no hardware state. If the fault persists, the code returns after a few drive cycles. Intermittent codes may be cleared and watched; currently active codes should be diagnosed first so the real fault is not masked.
map.故障码需用 OBD 读取器读取，数据流应在热车怠速稳定工况下采集: DTCs must be read with an OBD scanner; capture the data stream at warm, steady idle
